about: D1-D4 quest rewards (D5 Ancestral Secrets is a C# code request)

entries.why: Lady Leana gave two identical Silver Chains (cq_silver_chain and cq_alb_silver_chain, both level 8, +3 hits +1 power); the period walkthrough (Alb 33) and Wayback 2004 page give one: 'she will drop a Silver Chain. Reward: Silver Chain'

Minx Wiley handed out two pairs of Wiley's Boots (a wearable Price-0 copy from the kill and the reward from Hurg); walkthrough Mid 38: 'Kill him and you get Wiley's Boots', Hurg pays only coin ('You are rewarded 10 silver and some copper!'), so the kill gives the one real pair and Hurg pays 10 silver

Smyga's Raid left a realm-0 level-1 junk 'Smyga's Helm' token in the bag and gave the real helm at Carr; walkthrough Mid 414: 'Kill Smyga and you will receive Smyg's helm', so the kill gives the real Smyga's Helm once

row.Name: Dwarven Glima
row.Description: Classic quest reward (Hole of the Dead)

entries.source: Allakhazam item 1129 'Dwarven Glima' (period-data/archive/allakhazam-live/item.jsonl.gz, quest_item_links quest 96 'Hole of the Dead'): Ring, Dexterity +4, Level to Attain 6 (use 6-12), weight 0.70, quality 100, default bonus 0; comment 2002-03-19; model borrowed from a Midgard item of the same slot/type (no period page records models)
entries.why: period Hole of the Dead reward for Berserker, Skald, Thane and Warrior did not exist

row.Name: Dwarven Boots of Air
row.Description: Classic quest reward (Hole of the Dead)

entries.source: Allakhazam item 3632 'Dwarven Boots of Air' (period-data/archive/allakhazam-live/item.jsonl.gz, quest_item_links quest 96 'Hole of the Dead'): Feet, Leather, AF 14, absorb 10%, Quickness +7, Level to Attain 6, weight 0.00, quality 100, default bonus 5%; model borrowed from a Midgard item of the same slot/type (no period page records models)
entries.why: period Hole of the Dead reward for Hunters did not exist

row.Name: Gloves of the Eternal
row.Description: Classic quest reward (Hole of the Dead)

entries.source: Allakhazam item 4115 'Gloves of the Eternal' (period-data/archive/allakhazam-live/item.jsonl.gz, quest_item_links quest 96 'Hole of the Dead'): Hands, Cloth, AF 7, Piety +7, Level to Attain 6, weight 0.80, quality 100, default bonus 5%; page updated 2004-11-15; model borrowed from a Midgard item of the same slot/type (no period page records models)
entries.why: period Hole of the Dead reward for Healers and Runemasters did not exist

every class got Kelgor's Fists AND Kelgor's Hands, which Allakhazam (items 28444/28445) says are the Savage's class-joining gift used as the 'house gift' in this quest, not its reward; period rewards (walkthrough Mid 96, Wayback 2004): Dwarven Glima for Berserker/Skald/Thane/Warrior, Gloves of the Eternal for Healer/Runemaster, Dwarven Boots of Air for Hunter

Hole of the Dead rewards per class: Hunter (25) Dwarven Boots of Air, Healer (26) and Runemaster (29) Gloves of the Eternal; others keep the Dwarven Glima (no Savage reward is recorded, so Savages get the default Glima)
Copious Striders gave a realm-0 Reed Bracer; the period walkthrough (Mid 49, and the 2004 page) ends 'You are awarded 50 copper!' with no item, and the spec notes the Reed Bracer as added in 1.69
